title: Holistic stream credit reconciliation with late chunks and transient reconnects
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Investigate and implement a resilient reconciliation mechanism for streaming sessions that ensures correct per-session token/credit accounting when late or reordered chunks, transient reconnects, and partial terminal frames occur. Current metering pipeline occasionally assigns provisional credits which are never reconciled when final chunks arrive out-of-order or when clients reconnect with different session IDs. This leads to small but systemic billing drift for heavy streaming workloads and customer confusion during audits.
reproduction_steps: Create a streaming client that sends a long prompt, then simulates network partition after initial chunks are accepted but before finalizing the stream.
On reconnect, resume the stream over a different proxy path that uses a new session id but refers to same logical user request.
Inject reordered 'final' chunk delivery and duplicate fragments to the gateway to mimic lossy mobile networks.
Observe provisional credits assigned at accept-time and the absence of a definitive finalization step that reconciles provisional vs final token counts in the ledger.
proposed_solution: Introduce a compact per-session watermark & tombstone protocol: every stream fragment carries a monotonic fragment index and a session-level provisional checksum. Servers mark provisional credits with a short-lived anchor token tied to the session id plus index range.

Add idempotent finalize operation minted by the serving node that atomically moves provisional credits to final credits using anchor token. Finalize is retry-safe and deduplicated by ledger checkpoint ID.

Deploy a background reconciliation worker that consumes event stream of out-of-order/finalize timeouts and attempts to rehydrate missing fragments from the stream archive and then retro-apply credit adjustments. The worker writes audit entries and a reconciliation delta for accounting.

Expose a conservative short-window grace policy that prevents double-charging during speculative decoding/fanout: provision credits up to X tokens then hold final debits until finalize or timeout, with automatic rollback on stale sessions.
design_notes: Prefer low-latency finalize path for the common case (final arrives in-order) — finalize should be a single lightweight RPC with idempotency-key header.
The ledger schema will get two columns: provisional_debit_id and finalized_debit_id; provisional rows age out after reconciliation to prevent unbounded growth.
Engineering tradeoff: longer provisional window reduces false rollbacks but increases temporary exposure to overcommit. Default X=30s, tunable per customer tier.
Goal is not to eliminate all discrepancies immediately but to guarantee eventual consistency with clear audit trail and <0.01% net drift in synthetic workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic harness with 100k streaming sessions and injected reorders/reconnects shows net billing drift <= 0.01% over 24h run.
Finalize RPC is idempotent and reentrant: repeated finalize calls for same anchor must not change ledger after first success.
Reconciliation worker can retro-credit or debit sessions and produces human-readable audit rows with reason codes for every adjustment.
Dashboard shows per-hour provisional vs finalized credit delta; alert fires if delta exceeds configured threshold (default 0.5% per hour).
Integration tests covering: duplicate frames, truncated final chunk, out-of-order final after fast reconnect, compression-wrapped fragments, and attachment-bearing fragments.
test_plan: Unit tests for anchor creation, finalize idempotency, tombstone/expiry semantics.
Integration scenario harness that replays captured real-world fragment timelines (mobile traces) against the new reconcile flow.
Load test at 2x expected peak with long tail of reorders to validate reconciliation worker throughput and memory usage.
E2E billing smoke: create sandbox account, run streaming session with induced late final, assert sandbox invoice matches expected token counts after reconciliation.
rollout_plan: Feature-flag the finalize + reconciliation worker. Start with internal tenant and <1% of production traffic for 72 hours.
Monitor provisional/final deltas and reconciliation throughput; if OK, expand to staged rollout by region and customer tier over 2 weeks.
Fallback: disable finalize path and let reconciliation worker operate in passive audit-only mode until issues fixed.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Daniel Park: Spiked finalize RPC and verified idempotency semantics locally. Observed race where duplicate finalize calls from two nodes caused transient double-delta; adding ledger-level compare-and-swap.
2026-02-22 - Aisha Kaur: Design review with security—KMS usage not required for anchors but audit trail must be tamper-evident. Decided to include signed anchor tokens via HMAC with a rotating key.
2026-03-03 - QA: Began integration harness run with 10k sessions; saw reconciliation worker lag under high reorder rate. Plan to add batching to worker and optimize fragment lookup path.
2026-03-12 - Daniel Park: Implemented ledger migration to add provisional_debit_id and smoke-tested migration in staging. No regressions observed.
